Resolves the run_id collision trap flagged during RE17's design review: every run-scoped filesystem/ArtifactStore path in campaign_execution.py/campaign_workers.py is keyed on run_id alone, so run_campaign() derives a distinct execution run_id per lane from the shared campaign run_id plus the lane's own stable identity, rather than sharing one run_id across lanes -- fixed at this seam with no changes needed to the lower layers. Deliberately sequential, not a unified CampaignGraph across lanes. 10 new unit tests. Verified on real Brutus hardware: a two-lane run_campaign() call (stock + tune) sharing one campaign run_id succeeded on gfx1100 with distinct per-lane execution run_ids and no path collision, stock correctly skipping generate/workload/smoke and tune correctly running the full chain with build reuse.

technical-summary: HI68 (RV49/F2, P0): the noise-canary retry no longer replaces final-stage statistics.
